ns2:course.label: Earth Dams
ns2:course.description: Fundamentals of slope stability; seepage in composite sections and anisotropic materials; methods of stability analysis; mechanism of failure of natural and artificial slopes; compaction; field observations. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in CEE 484.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in CEE 484.
